scope.phase: P3 provider logical-turn and actual-network-request accounting

sourceClosure.summary: Version provider request accounting schema and migration.
Freeze provider retry policy and keep validation calls at zero retries.
Persist append-only request attempts before network I/O and terminal outcomes after it.
Bind actual requests to durable T1-T4 and direct cognitive-turn receipts.
Discard provider results that return after authoritative cancellation.
Freeze attempted and succeeded actual-request counts in first-qualified receipts.
Normalize legacy nullable request counters without reducing consumed work.
Preserve one ORM/module identity while rebinding per-test databases, eliminating collection-order pollution.

accountingContract.logicalTurns: Counted independently from actual provider network requests.
accountingContract.actualRequests: Attempt is persisted before I/O; succeeded, failed, or indeterminate outcome is append-only and consumes the cap.
accountingContract.retryPolicy: Every physical retry or compatibility fallback is an explicit additional request; validation uses max_retries=0.
capturedMetadata: prompt/evidence/schema/tool hashes and UTF-8 byte counts
latency and frozen price-snapshot cost when available
